body.message:
Dear 

I’m sorry, but this is not acceptable. I came to your office as requested, but no one responded to me, and even the building reception did not have any contact number for your office.

Now you are telling me that you will send me the location. Am I expected to cancel my plans and spend my entire day waiting for you to respond because of the unacceptable and unhygienic condition of the apartment you rented to me?

I have already spent enough time and money dealing with this situation, and I don’t think it is reasonable to keep delaying the matter.

Regarding the refund, please transfer the money back to the card I used for the booking. If you are unable to process the refund to that card, I can provide another card and send you the details.

I expect this matter to be resolved without any further delay.
